harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Hardened /tmp and /dev/shm on node1 with noexec,nosuid,nodev via persistent /etc/fstab tmpfs entries, verified enforcement functionally before and after a full reboot, and confirmed the node's boot identity changed (restart proof) with settings surviving.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline mount/fstab state on node1 (Alpine 3.23.3)
Backed up /etc/fstab and appended tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime
Applied immediately via `mount /tmp` and `mount -o remount /dev/shm`
Functionally verified noexec (script execution denied), nosuid (setuid busybox binary execution denied), and nodev (device node open denied) on both mounts
Captured pre-reboot boot_id baseline
Triggered a native reboot via backgrounded `reboot` so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed new boot_id differs from baseline, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified /etc/fstab and live mount options for /tmp and /dev/shm post-reboot
Re-ran the noexec/nosuid/nodev functional checks post-reboot to confirm persistence

evidence.summary: Showed /dev/shm already tmpfs but with no fstab entry, and /tmp was not a separate mount at all; neither had fstab entries.

evidence.requirement: fstab updated with persistent noexec,nosuid,nodev options for /tmp and /dev/shm
evidence.summary: Backed up fstab and appended tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime.

evidence.requirement: Mount options applied live and match fstab
evidence.summary: mount /tmp and remount of /dev/shm show both as tmpfs with nosuid,nodev,noexec.

evidence.requirement: noexec, nosuid, nodev functionally enforced pre-reboot
evidence.summary: Script execution from /tmp denied (exit 126), setuid busybox execution from /dev/shm denied (exit 126), and opening a device node created in /tmp denied (Permission denied) despite mknod itself succeeding.

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline boot identity captured before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id f3e63865-c712-4b78-90cd-97c193bd1d83 and confirmed both mounts healthy just before reboot.
Backgrounded `reboot` command acknowledged (reboot_scheduled) and returned before the node disconnected on the next call.

evidence.requirement: Node restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Node was unreachable through several poll attempts (connection reset/timeout) during reboot, then exec availability returned with a new boot_id ca0d1bc4-614c-475a-b0b7-f7947d397461 (differs from baseline) and uptime of 0 minutes, proving an actual restart.
Post-reboot mount and fstab output show /tmp and /dev/shm both mounted tmpfs with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec, matching the fstab entries added earlier.

evidence.requirement: noexec, nosuid, nodev functionally enforced post-reboot
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: script execution from /tmp denied, setuid busybox execution from /dev/shm denied, and device node access from /tmp denied — confirming the hardening is active and persistent after restart.

attempts.summary: Hardened /tmp and /dev/shm on node1 with noexec,nosuid,nodev via persistent /etc/fstab tmpfs entries, verified enforcement functionally before and after a full reboot, and confirmed the node's boot identity changed (restart proof) with settings surviving.
